desc: Audit endpoint handlers for business logic leakage and separation of concerns
context: Read all files in app/api/**. Check whether handlers contain embedded business logic that should live in service classes. Look for direct LLM calls, database queries, or domain computations inside handler functions. Note any violations.
acceptance_criteria: Each handler file has been read and assessed
Business logic violations are documented with file and line evidence
Findings are formatted as assertions with evidence for the final report
